anomalies.expected: A pull-up should have a suitably high resistance; the other MCU pull-up resistors shown, R2 and R11, are 10 kΩ. R6 should likewise be a high-value pull-up rather than 10 Ω.

evidence.quote: R6 10; connected between +3V3 and GPIO2 (sheet /Microcontroller/, page 2/4).

anomalies.impact: The 10 Ω resistor strongly biases GPIO2 high and can draw excessive current if GPIO2 is driven low, potentially overloading the pin or resistor.

parsed.summary: R6 is shown as 10 Ω in the GPIO2 pull-up position, unlike the 10 kΩ MCU pull-ups nearby. This unusually low value can cause excessive current whenever GPIO2 is pulled low.
